title: the impact of work–family equilibrium on employee proactive behaviors
core_idea: Investigate how equilibrium states between work–family conflict and work–family facilitation relate to employees' proactive behaviors, using resource conservation theory and testing mediating roles of emotional exhaustion and psychological capital with polynomial regression and response surface analysis on multi-source organizational data.
tldr: Examines the relationship between work–family conflict/facilitation equilibrium and employee proactive behavior using data from 126 companies (1,354 employees, 142 HR managers), applying polynomial regression and response surface analysis and testing emotional exhaustion and psychological capital as mediators.
